name: agents-kanban-relay
description: The relay that Agents Kanban pushes its board to — runs on Netlify, Cloudflare Workers or any Node server. This repository is the deployable relay, split out of the extension repo (../Agents-Kanban/), which pins the shared rules in remote-contract.json.

scripts.test: node tests/handler.test.mjs && node tests/worker.test.mjs && node tests/server.test.mjs && node tests/contract.test.mjs && node tests/media-sync.test.mjs && node tests/bridge.test.mjs && node --check functions/board.mjs && node --check functions/board-core.mjs && node --check server.js && node --check worker.js && node --check public/bridge.js && node --check public/media/board.js
